reward: minus mean absolute longitudinal displacement from actual physical x0 over ticks 1..32, metres

attribution_definition.slope_error: For each seed take the median of all six abs(AD-native FD)/max(abs(AD),abs(native FD)) errors on the same physical curves; a zero denominator is undefined.
attribution_definition.baseline_error: For each seed take the median of all three absolute neutral H32 return prediction errors in metres.
